records.description: SBA's primary business loan program. SBA guarantees part of a participating lender's loan to an eligible small business for a broad range of business purposes.
eligibility: Operating, for-profit business located in the United States
Creditworthy and able to demonstrate a reasonable ability to repay
Unable to obtain the desired credit on reasonable terms from non-government sources
eligible_uses: Acquire, refinance, or improve real estate and buildings
Purchase and install machinery and equipment, including AI-related expenses
how_to_start: Use SBA Lender Match or contact an SBA-approved local lender.
Discuss the appropriate 7(a) loan type and documentation with the lender.
Apply directly through the lender; the lender processes the application.

records.raw_text: SBA's primary business loan program provides a loan guarantee to lenders that offer financial assistance to small businesses. Maximum loan amount: $5 million. Apply directly through a local participating lender or use SBA Lender Match.
required_evidence: Application documents required by the participating lender
Evidence of creditworthiness and ability to repay
records.short_description: SBA-guaranteed general-purpose financing for eligible U.S. small businesses.

records.description: Long-term, fixed-rate financing for major fixed assets that promote business growth and job creation, delivered through SBA Certified Development Companies and senior lenders.
eligibility: Operating, for-profit business located in the United States
Has qualified management expertise, a feasible business plan, good character, and ability to repay
Not engaged in nonprofit, passive, or speculative activities
eligible_uses: Purchase, construct, or renovate buildings or land
Purchase long-term machinery and equipment with at least 10 years of useful remaining life
Consolidate or refinance qualified debt, subject to SBA rules
how_to_start: Find and contact an SBA Certified Development Company (CDC) in your area.
Work with the CDC and a senior lender to structure the project financing.
Submit the documentation requested by the CDC and lenders.

required_evidence: Evidence of qualified management and ability to repay
Project and asset documentation required by the CDC and lenders

records.description: Low-interest direct disaster recovery loans for businesses of any size in a declared disaster area, to repair or replace business property damaged by the disaster.
eligibility: Business of any size located in a declared disaster area
Business property or other eligible assets were damaged by the declared disaster
Disaster losses are not fully covered by insurance or other sources
eligible_uses: Repair or replace machinery and equipment
how_to_start: Check the SBA disaster declaration and county eligibility.
Apply online through the SBA Loan Portal.
Submit the completed application for SBA inspection and processing.

location: United States; declared disaster areas only
money: No interest accrues during the first 12 months

records.short_description: Direct low-interest recovery financing for business property damage in declared disaster areas.
